Snackvivor: Concession Cove - the-cornucopia

Snackvivor: Concession Cove
The Ruins Of The Hungry Games / the-cornucopia
Foolish's Confessional
Swedish Fish 1/30/2025 4:05 PM
Swedish Fish 1/30/2025 4:36 PM
Normally when arriving on a Survivor beach things are a lot more tropical, but not here... Something about this place seems familiar... That's when you spot it- A cornucopia. Suddenly it all makes sense. This is no ordinary beach, but rather the ruins of the Hungry Games arena... As your tribe gets close to the center, you notice other tribes coming out of the woods as well. You all arrive at roughly the same time, but you also notice something perculiar. A sign in the middle of the cornucopia with very clear instructions. The sign reads- "Hello everyone and welcome to the pseudo-s8 Safari Zone! As you can see we brought representatives from each season here and we thought for this phase it would be fun to give a little nod to two former seasons- The Hungry Games and The Great Girl Scout Jamboree..." The sign continues- "For this tribe phase you will all have the ability to speak to each other PUBLICALLY in this channel. However, you see three distinct paths leading into the distance, all towards the ruined Girl Scout Jamboree section of the Hungry Games Arena. If you choose to embark on one of these paths, you will permanently lose access to this channel, but GAIN access to the channel of the path you take. But be warned, so will anyone who went the same path as you! At the end of each path is a hunt of varying difficulty. You can only take one path, and you CANNOT turn back!" This abnormally long sign keeps going, like geez who yaps this much am I right- "At the end of the tribe phase, the individual who has successfully completed their path's task in the fastest time will earn a reward, but there may be some rewards for those who finish a little bit after! Now of course, you don't have to take any path if you don't want. You can always stay here in the middle and talk amongst anyone else who stays. But no rewards will be found here... If you take the same path as someone else, you can continue to keep talking to them there. We will NOT reveal which player, if any, got a reward on each path and no rewards will be handed out until the phase is over!" The sign somehow continues- "The three paths you can take are: - The Lemon Trees (Easy) - The Double Stuf Deep Woods (Medium) - The Sunken Jury (Hard) If you wish to take a path you must ping production in your private submission channel and say which path you are taking and they will move you accordingly" The sign, which must be a mile long at this point, says one more thing to you all- "May the odds be ever in your flavor..."
